details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:607-612 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_normalize_optional_text` turns `False` into the string `"False"` instead of treating it as absent.
  WHY: The reviewer shows this violates the optional-text contract and can silently store malformed values if the helper is called directly.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6901-6918 | severity=medium | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `infer_validation_raw_status` falls back to grepping hard-coded English phrases from `validate_process.sh` to detect harness errors.
  WHY: When the primary `gh run view --json outputs` path is unavailable, wording changes in the other script can make harness failures stop matching and be misclassified.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5218-5286 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `validation_history_gate_decision_for_current_sha` treats `"failed"` and `"fail"` as failures but does not treat `"error"` as a fail synonym.
  WHY: A run with `outcome="error"` can be ignored by the gate, allowing promotion while an unresolved error state exists.
- scripts/ai_memory.py:83-91 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `try/except ValueError` around `_safe_int()` in `_require_positive_int` is dead code.
  WHY: `_safe_int()` returns `None` on parse failure rather than raising, so the wrapper implies an error contract the helper does not provide.
- .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json:109-117 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The three new additive labels were added to the contract but not listed in the `phase_groups/additive` section.
  WHY: Consumers expect additive labels to appear there, so omitting them makes them look phase-specific.
- .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json:109-117 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new label entries in the contract are only partially synchronized with `scripts/label_helpers.sh`'s `_AI_LABEL_COLORS` and `_AI_LABEL_DESCS`.
  WHY: The label reconciliation path can create mismatched colors/descriptions on consumer repos, breaking the single-source-of-truth contract.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5963 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `raw_status=harness_error` branch updates labels/comments but does not persist the state file in all call-sites.
  WHY: Later judge/staleness/ready-to-merge checks can read stale JSON state and make promotion or recovery decisions from an out-of-sync model.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~7181 (and callers at 7426, 12600, 14077) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `ahead_by` is computed once per poll cycle and reused by backpressure, eager-draft promotion, staleness alerting, and validation-history gating.
  WHY: Concurrent poll ticks can change the integration-branch ahead count mid-cycle, letting backpressure or promotion decisions use stale data.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:~617-624 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_normalize_optional_text` and `_normalize_datetime_utc` can normalize booleans and naive ISO timestamps into malformed stored values instead of treating them as absent.
  WHY: The reviewer shows malformed memory records can propagate into the validation-history path and degrade the fail-open fallback that protects promotion gating.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~6933-6949 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `infer_validation_raw_status` fallback grep for `"harness_error"` is a long alternation of English phrases.
  WHY: When the primary `gh-run` JSON path is unavailable, wording changes in `validate_process.sh` can make harness defects stop matching and get misclassified as application failures.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

- requirement: Add `node-runtime` to the list of renderer-supported template families in README.md documentation.
  expected_change_site: README.md line mentioning "Renderer-supported template families are currently"
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: README.md still lists the old family set and omits `node-runtime`; x-ai also notes the README lacks the `custom_tests`/`skip_tests` semantics.
- requirement: "Add validation-resilience labels to the central label contract so the orchestrator can apply them by name." — specifically, the three new additive labels (ai:harness-broken, ai:force-merge, ai:integration-backpressure) must be listed in the phase_groups/additive section of the label contract.
  expected_change_site: .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json, phase_groups array entry for additive labels
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff adds the three labels to the top-level `labels` object but does not add them to any `phase_groups` entry.
- requirement: "Add the core node-runtime validation harness family (priority AC1) — including the 6 new .j2 files, registration in FAMILY_REGISTRY, example fixture, renderer test, and explicit documentation of custom_tests/skip_tests semantics."
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/ (plus scripts/render_validation_templates.py, tests/test_family_node_runtime.py, README.md)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The files were created and the family was registered, but the shell-based acceptance test stub `scripts/dev/test_render_node_runtime.sh` named in the plan is missing, and README.md still lists the old family set without mentioning node-runtime or its controls.
- requirement: "Teach the poller and judge prompts to treat harness_error and active ai:harness-broken labels as infrastructure failures (not application regressions) during final-merge and review/autofix."
  expected_change_site: prompts/mode-judge.txt and prompts/mode-orchestrate-poll-judge.txt (rules section)
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The new rule text was added near the bottom of both files rather than under the evaluation criteria/rules heading where it would be read first.
- requirement: "Add deterministic AI-memory primitives for validation history, operator bypass audit, and revalidate events so the orchestrator can write/read deterministically identifiable records (validation_history.v1, operator_bypass_audit.v1, revalidate_events.v1)."
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_memory_lib.py (schema constants, validation helpers, _*path functions)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The three JSON schemas were added, but `ai_memory_lib.py` still lacks the full set of normalization/path helpers, leaving some read/write paths in the fail-open state.
- requirement: "scripts/dev/test_harness_error_budget.sh (PR B), plus the six additional shell acceptance-test stubs for PR C and PR D."
  expected_change_site: scripts/dev/ (listed explicitly in the plan's Files & Modules table)
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: None of the named shell stubs exist; test coverage was implemented in Python under `tests/` instead.
